profile.summary: caub is a mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in Express.js backend development. Their contributions focus on core framework improvements, including server lifecycle management, routing introspection, and error handling middleware. The developer demonstrates strong proficiency in modern JavaScript patterns (Promises/async-await) and deep knowledge of Express's internal architecture. While contributions are backend-focused, the profile highlights collaborative open-source work on a major Node.js framework.

PR 'allow to send custom errors' extends Express's error handling middleware to support custom error responses
All PRs target Express.js core modules (router, server, error handling), demonstrating deep framework knowledge
Contributions labeled 'enhancement' and 'module:router', indicating structured, maintainable improvements
No frontend or testing-related PRs visible, confirming backend specialization
Modernization efforts visible in Promise-based server APIs (callback → async/await conversion)
